01-distributed-design: Two software engineers, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, stand at the glass wall of a bright modern office overlooking a clean, sunlit parcel sorting hall; he points down at plain unlabelled parcels passing a scanner arch on a conveyor while she holds an open laptop showing a softly blurred diagram of coloured boxes and arrows.
02-aspire: A software engineer in her early thirties at a bright corner desk by a window leans back with a relieved smile as the wide monitor in front of her shows a grid of softly blurred tiles that have all turned green, one hand still resting on the laptop keyboard.
03-hosting: A software engineer at a white standing desk by a tall window starts a cloud deployment on her laptop while a colleague beside her, coffee cup in hand, watches the screen, both smiling.
04-service-bus: Two software engineers, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, stand beside tidy shelves of plain cardboard parcels in a bright modern logistics depot office; she holds a tablet with its screen facing the viewer showing soft coloured rows, he points at one parcel on the shelf, both smiling; the parcel labels are blank and the cartons carry no print.
05-event-grid-hubs: A software engineer in her early thirties photographs a plain unlabelled cardboard parcel on a light-oak desk with her phone, while a colleague in his late twenties watches a laptop showing softly blurred coloured lines beside it, both smiling, in a bright daylight office.
06-event-sourcing-cqrs: Two software engineers at a tall glass wall in a bright logistics office, a woman placing an orange sticky note at the end of a long horizontal row of blank orange sticky notes joined by hand-drawn arrows, a man beside her holding an open laptop and smiling, every note blank with no writing.
07-dapr: Two software engineers in a bright, modern parcel depot stand beside a white delivery van with its side door open, one holding an open laptop and the other a tablet, checking the plain brown cartons without labels on the shelves inside the van.
08-durable-execution: A software engineer in the bright engineering room of a modern parcel delivery company stands beside light-oak shelves of plain, unlabelled cardboard parcels and checks a tablet that shows a softly blurred chain of workflow steps.
09-ai-agents: An operations engineer in her early thirties at a bright desk reviews a drafted customer notice on a large monitor of soft blurred cards and approves a parcel reroute with one click, while a male colleague beside her holds a plain unlabelled parcel box.
